- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.6) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.3) — add 3–7% to forecast to compensate for mean reversion bias.
- Overshoot after sharp upward spikes — cap forecast 3–5 days post-spike at 10–15% below peak.
- Lagged price movements: if sentiment rises sharply, delay forecast peak by 1–2 days; if sentiment falls, anticipate early correction.
- Mean reversion bias: if 3–5 consecutive days show downward trend, reduce forecast slope by 10–15%.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts overestimate volatility in low-sentiment periods — dampen forecast variance by 20–30%.
